overview: Task graph for generating a frozen-snapshot FY2024 research report on Tencent Holdings (0700.HK). The report must include executive summary, financial statements/gaps, valuation/limitations, risks, and investment conclusion, with all factual claims explicitly cited.
research_topic: 腾讯控股 (0700.HK) formal FY2024 frozen-input report
requirements: Cover executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation or limitation, risks, and investment conclusion.
Emit explicitly labeled critical claims and body citations.

tasks.description: Retrieve frozen snapshot evidence for Tencent Holdings (0700.HK) FY2024. Use evidence_discovery skills: locate company filings, financial statements, market snapshots, recent news, and analyst reports. Output ranked evidence candidates with citation-ready evidence records.
tasks.expected_output: List of evidence records with evidence_id, source, date, content summary, and relevance score.

tasks.description: Perform financial statement analysis on Tencent FY2024 using evidence from task_001. Compute key financial ratios, trends, three-statement view (income, balance, cash flow), peer comparison, and valuation (DCF or multiples). Output evidence-backed claims, tables, metrics, valuation model, and sensitivity artifacts.
tasks.expected_output: Structured financial analysis with tables, ratio list, valuation range, and sensitivity analysis, all with evidence_ids.

tasks.description: Draft the qualitative sections: executive summary, risk analysis, and investment conclusion. Use evidence from task_001 and financial insights from task_002. Ensure each critical claim has an explicit evidence_id citation.
tasks.expected_output: Draft text for executive summary, risks, and conclusion with embedded citations.

tasks.description: Assemble the final report in Markdown, HTML, and JSON formats. Integrate all sections (executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation/limitations, risks, investment conclusion) with charts and compliance disclosure. Use report_assembly skills. Ensure all claims are cited.
tasks.expected_output: Complete report payloads (markdown, html, json) with citations, charts, and compliance disclosure.

tasks.description: Verify the assembled report from task_004. Check that every material factual claim has an explicit evidence_id citation, no invented numbers/dates/sources, and compliance requirements are met. Provide revision feedback if needed.
tasks.expected_output: Verification pass/fail report with detailed feedback. If fails, loop back to task_004 for revision until pass.
